run_oneshot_prompt: run a single AI prompt in oneshot mode and print only the final response to stdout
run_oneshot_with_model: run a single AI prompt with a specific model and provider in oneshot mode
run_oneshot_silent: run a single AI prompt with all logging suppressed and auto approvals enabled
run_agent_internal: build an AIAgent instance with resolved model provider and toolsets then run a single chat turn
oneshot_clarify_callback: handle agent clarification requests in non-interactive oneshot mode by instructing the agent to pick a default
